_readme: Known symbols for ES1's GO.EXE (ES1GO): confirmed address -> meaning mappings, applied to the ES1Recon Ghidra project by ES2ApplySymbolNames.java.
Addresses are offsets into the flat X-32 image (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/x32-executable.md#the-image).
Schema, confidence rules and run order: tools/ghidra_scripts/README.md, 'Known symbols'.
Entries are in address order. tools/scripts/es2_naming.py insert and edit keep it, and check that it holds.

entries.name: X32_AllocMemory
entries.description: (size), C convention: ES1DBSIM's X32_AllocMemory (000001d7), its high-water mark at 0007d554 and EDX stored at 0007d550. Rounds size up to a multiple of 0x1000 and asks the extender for it (INT 21h AX=350Ch); returns the block's address, or -1 on carry.

entries.name: __x386_coproc_init
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__x386_coproc_init`, from `x386.asm`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 86 bytes from here.

entries.name: ClassItem_RegisterBucket
entries.description: (count, entries) in stack order, callee-cleaned: when count is nonzero, appends {entries, count} to the bucket list at 000aa114 (8 bytes per bucket, entries first) and increments its count 0007d788. Light_ResetSystem (000641ec) registers g_TSObjectTypeRegistry with it; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_RegisterBucket (0005513c) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_StoreItem
entries.description: (item, mode, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes one class item. Points the current-frame pointer 0009a2c8 at a frame on its stack and restores it on exit. When the item's body length (vtable +8) is 0 and the stream's slot +0x10 answers query 3 with 0, it makes a stream over the stream on its stack (0004f08c(local, 0, 0, stream)), opens the item in it (00000bfb) with the item's tag (vtable +4), calls the item's write slot (+0x14) with (mode, that stream), closes the item (00000dc4) and destroys the stream (0004f128, flags 2); otherwise it runs the same open, write and close on the stream itself; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_StoreItem (00055248) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_ItemTotalSize
entries.description: (item), callee-cleaned: builds {tag = vtable +4, length = vtable +8} on its stack and returns 00000b00 of it, or 0 when the length is 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_ItemTotalSize (00055610) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_DebugPrintType
entries.description: (item, indent, unused) in stack order, callee-cleaned: prints indent spaces and 'Class type: %d:%d' with the high and low words of the item's tag (vtable +4) to stdout, then ' "%s"' with the name in the handler entry 00000a30 finds for the tag, when it finds one, and a newline; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_DebugPrintType (00055648) in different code.

entries.name: Heap_Ctor
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: the heap object's constructor. With a null this it allocates 0x10 bytes through operator_new and returns 0 if that fails. Stores the address 000aa24a at 000aa24a. Returns the global heap 0009a308 untouched; any other heap gets its four dwords zeroed.

entries.name: Heap_Init
entries.description: (heap, block, size), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Init without the low mark: +0 base, +4 the size as given, +8 the free list (the block, its link zeroed), +0xc and the block's own size the size rounded down to a multiple of 8, and FBLK at the block's +8.

entries.name: Heap_IsAllocated
entries.description: (heap, payload): 1 when the payload lies from the heap's base to its end (+0 + +4) and its header (payload - 8) holds ABLK, else 0.

entries.name: Heap_IsBlock
entries.description: (heap, block header): ES1DBSIM's Heap_IsBlock. 1 when the address lies from the heap's base to 0x10 bytes before its end and carries FBLK at +8 or ABLK at +0, else 0.

entries.name: Heap_IsValidAllocation
entries.description: (heap, payload): 0 unless Heap_IsAllocated. Then 1 when the block's end (header + size) equals the heap's base plus 8 times the dword at +4, which Heap_Init sets to the size in bytes; otherwise Heap_IsBlock on the block's own header.

entries.name: Heap_LargestFree
entries.description: (heap): the largest size on the free list less the 8-byte header. Reads the list's head without testing it for null.

entries.name: Heap_Alloc
entries.description: (heap, size), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Alloc without the trackLow argument and the low mark. First fit on (size + 8) rounded up to 8: an exact block is unlinked, one more than 0x10 bytes larger is split with the tail left free (FBLK); tags the block ABLK, zero-fills the payload, takes the size off +0xc and returns the payload. 0 for size 0 or when nothing fits.

entries.name: Heap_Free
entries.description: (heap, payload), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Free. Nothing for null; otherwise adds the size back to +0xc, tags the block FBLK, inserts it into the free list in address order and merges it with touching free neighbours.

entries.name: Heap_Realloc
entries.description: (heap, size, payload), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Realloc with its branches inverted and returning early, and without the low mark. Size 0 frees; a smaller size gives the tail to a following free block, frees it as its own block when over 0x10 bytes, or moves the data; a larger size takes it from a following free block that has room, or moves the data. Calls Heap_IsBlock, Heap_FindPrevFree, Heap_Alloc, Heap_Free and memmove.

entries.name: Heap_DrawMap
entries.description: (heap, rows, columns, top, left), callee-cleaned (RET 0x14): divides the heap's +4 size into rows x columns equal shares and walks the global heap 0009a308's blocks with HeapIter_Init and HeapIter_Next, working out for each cell the share of its bytes in ABLK blocks. Each cell is passed to Mono_Printf (0004f904) with left + column, top + row, 0007d7b0 and a character by that share: 7 for none, 0xb1 below 50%, 0xb2 below 100% and 0xdb for all.

entries.name: Heap_FindPrevFree
entries.description: (heap, block): ES1DBSIM's Heap_FindPrevFree. The free block whose link is the given block; 0 when it heads the list or the walk ends.

entries.name: HeapIter_Init
entries.description: (this, heap), callee-cleaned: a two-dword heap walker. With a null this it allocates 8 bytes through operator_new and returns 0 if that fails. Stores the heap at +0 and the heap's base, its first block, at +4.

entries.name: HeapIter_Next
entries.description: (walker), callee-cleaned: returns 0 when the walker's block (+4) is 0. Otherwise steps +4 on by the block's size, sets it to 0 when that reaches the heap's base plus size, and returns the new +4.

entries.name: Mem_InitHeap
entries.description: (size): ES1DBSIM's Mem_InitHeap with the cap at X32_LargestFreeBlock() - 15000: takes the block from X32_AllocMemory, asserting 'Memory alloc failed' (src\memory.cpp line 494, severity 5) through Assert_Report when that returns -1, makes it the heap 0009a308 (Heap_Init) and sets 0007d7b4.

entries.name: Mem_HeapOff
entries.description: Clears 0007d7b4, after which operator new and malloc take memory from X32_AllocMemory and the frees do nothing.

entries.name: operator_new
entries.description: The program's operator new (size), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Alloc(0009a308, size) while 0007d7b4 is set, otherwise X32_AllocMemory(size) with -1 returned as 0.

entries.name: Mem_AllocFromHeap
entries.description: (heap, size), callee-cleaned (RET 8): Heap_Alloc(heap, size) on the heap it is given.

entries.name: operator_delete
entries.description: The program's operator delete (pointer), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Free(0009a308, pointer) while 0007d7b4 is set, otherwise nothing.

entries.name: malloc
entries.description: The program's malloc (size), C convention: operator_new's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: free
entries.description: The program's free (pointer), C convention: operator_delete's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: realloc
entries.description: The program's realloc (pointer, size), C convention: Heap_Realloc(0009a308, size, pointer), whether or not 0007d7b4 is set.

entries.name: calloc
entries.description: The program's calloc (count, size), C convention: ES1DBSIM's calloc over the heap 0009a308 and flag 0007d7b4. Clears the block over the size in the header before it, which a block from X32_AllocMemory does not have.

entries.name: Mem_ConstructHeap
entries.description: No arguments, C convention: Heap_Ctor(0009a308), the global heap.

entries.name: Raster_DrawLine
entries.description: (from, to), C convention: draws a line between two {x, y} points with the pen at the installed clip block's +0x224 (the block 0008441c points at): mode 0 a flat colour, mode 2 a span remap through g_RasterRoutines slot 1 (000865b4), a colour whose top byte is 4 read from the colour ramps at 00085da9. The points move by the block's translation when +0x208 is set. Clip mode 0 draws the whole line and mode 1 the line clipped to the rect at +0x20c (0004ffac): a flat colour through slot 34 (00086638), a remap as the spans 0004fe60 scan-converts it to. Other modes take each region of the list at +0: a rect region clips the line with 0004ffac, a span region intersects the line's spans with it through 0004fc50, and each piece goes to the pen's span routine. The code of ES1DBSIM's Raster_DrawLine (0006a064), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: SoundObject_SetPosition
entries.description: (object, point) in stack order, callee-cleaned: sets the positional byte +0x15, copies the point's three ints to +0x25, +0x29 and +0x2d, and calls 0004360e(the manager +0x11, the channel byte +8). The code of ES1DBSIM's SoundObject_SetPosition (00050120), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: Volume_Ctor
entries.description: Volume constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0x30 bytes through operator_new when this is null (0 if that fails), then clears the file stream +0, the buffered stream +4 and the arrays +0x24, +0x28 and +0x2c. The class stores no vptr; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's Volume_Ctor (00055d20) in different code.

entries.name: Volume_Dtor
entries.description: Volume destructor (this, flags): returns at once for a null this; otherwise operator_delete on each of the arrays +0x24, +0x28 and +0x2c that is set, deletes the buffered stream +4 and then the file stream +0 through their slot +4 with flags 3, and operator_delete on this when bit 0 of the flags is set; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's Volume_Dtor (00055d50) in different code.

entries.name: Volume_LoadVolume
entries.description: (bufferSize, mask, path) in stack order, callee-cleaned: opens path with FileRStream_Ctor and reads the 3-byte signature, which must equal 'VOL' (0008b044), a revision byte it ignores and the flags dword; when the flags share a bit with mask, wraps the file in BuffRStream_Ctor with a buffer of bufferSize bytes, 0x80 when smaller, and builds the volume with Volume_Ctor: file stream +0, buffered stream +4, path copied to +8, flags +0x20, then from the buffered stream the byte +0x1c, the directory count +0x1d, the directory-name block (word size, into +0x28, with +0x24 pointing at each name), the entry count +0x1e and the 0x12-byte entries (dword size, into +0x2c). Returns the volume, or 0 after Volume_Dtor(volume, 3) when the buffered stream's status is nonzero. A file that does not open, a wrong signature or flags sharing no bit with mask delete the file stream and return 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's Volume_LoadVolume (00055dc8) in different code.

entries.name: Volume_FindEntry
entries.description: (volume, entry, path) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Path_Split's path into the static buffers 000ab72e (drive), 000ab732 (dir), 000ab774 (name) and 000ab77e (ext); when drive and dir are not empty, finds them among the directory names (+0x24, count +0x1d) with stricmp and returns 0 when none matches; then finds the first 0x12-byte entry (+0x2c, count +0x1e) whose directory index (+0xd) is that directory, or 0xff for none, and whose name equals name and ext with stricmp. On a hit it seeks the buffered stream +4 to the entry's offset (+0xe) through its slot +0xc, reads the entry's 9-byte prefix through its slot +0x1c, and fills entry: dword [0] the buffered stream, [2] and [4] the offset + 9, [5] the prefix's type byte and [6] its size dword; returns 1. Returns 0 when no entry matches; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's Volume_FindEntry (00055ff4) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Ctor
entries.description: VolRStream() constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0x2f bytes through operator_new when this is null (0 if that fails), Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00083c16 at +4, clears the filters +0x27 and +0x2b and the entry fields +0xa, +0xe and +0x16, handle -1 at +8 and status 5 at +0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Ctor (00056710) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_CtorFromHandle
entries.description: VolRStream(handle) constructor, callee-cleaned: VolRStream_Ctor's allocation and clearing, then adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0x26 = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR), VolRStream_SetIoError on -1; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_CtorFromHandle (00056760) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_CtorFromPath
entries.description: VolRStream(path) constructor, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x2f bytes when this is null, Stream_BaseCtor, the vtable 00083c16, clears +0x27, +0x2b, +0xa, +0xe, +0x16, handle -1, +0x26 cleared, then VolRStream_Open(path); the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_CtorFromPath (000567cc) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Dtor
entries.description: VolRStream destructor (this, flags), vtable slot +4: restores the vtable 00083c16, deletes the filters at +0x27 and +0x2b through their own slot +4 with flags 3, VolRStream_Close, Stream_BaseDtor(this, 0), and operator_delete when bit 0 of the flags is set; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Dtor (00056824) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_SetFile
entries.description: (stream, handle): VolRStream_Close, adopts the handle at +8 without owning it (+0x26 = 0) and probes it with lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR): status 0 on success, VolRStream_SetIoError on -1; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_SetFile (0005688c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Close
entries.description: (stream): closes the handle at +8 when the stream owns it (+0x26) and it is not -1, returning 0 with status 3 when close fails; passes the RLE filter +0x27 to RLERStream_Close (00064560) and the LZH filter +0x2b to LZHRStream_Close (00065000) when set; clears +0xa, +0xe and +0x16, sets the handle to -1 and status 5, and returns 1; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Close (000568d0) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Open
entries.description: (stream, path): VolRStream_Close, clears +0xa, +0xe and +0x16, then open(path, 0) into the handle at +8. When that fails it looks the path up in the volume group g_VolumeGroup (00083c04) through VolumeGroup_FindEntry (0004dd96), which fills the entry fields from +0xa; with no group or no entry it sets status 1 and returns 0. By the entry's compression type at +0x1e it reads through: 2, the volume's stream itself (+0xe = +0xa); 7, the RLE filter at +0x27 (made by RLERStream_Ctor (00064460) on first use and attached by RLERStream_Open (0006452c)); 9, the LZH filter at +0x2b (LZHRStream_Ctor (00064ec0), LZHRStream_Open (00064fa4)). Then status 0 and +0x26 = 1, also for a volume entry, and returns 1; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Open (00056944) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_SetGroup
entries.description: (a, b, c, d): makes the volume group g_VolumeGroup (00083c04) through VolumeGroup_Ctor (0004d82c)(0, a, b, c, d) on first use, otherwise passes the same arguments to VolumeGroup_SetGroup (0004d98f) on it; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_SetGroup (00056a38) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_DeleteGroup
entries.description: (): when the volume group g_VolumeGroup (00083c04) is set, VolumeGroup_Dtor (0004d89a)(group, 3) and clears g_VolumeGroup (00083c04). es2_xref finds one call, from main (00012ec7); the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_DeleteGroup (00056a7c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_LoadVolume
entries.description: (path): passes the path to VolumeGroup_LoadVolume (0004dcf7) on the volume group g_VolumeGroup (00083c04); the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_LoadVolume (00056aa0) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_GetSize
entries.description: (stream): filelength of the handle at +8 when there is one, otherwise the entry size +0x22 when an entry is open (+0xe), else 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_GetSize (00056ab8) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_GetPosition
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +8 (stream): lseek(h, 0, SEEK_CUR) for a file handle, the position in the entry (+0x16) when one is open, else 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_GetPosition (00056b00) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_SetPosition
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0xc (stream, position): a status of 2 is cleared first, and any other nonzero status returns 0. A file handle seeks with lseek(h, position, SEEK_SET), VolRStream_SetIoError on -1. An open entry stores the position at +0x16 and at +0x1a the absolute offset +0x12 + position, or, when the position is not below the size +0x22, the size itself with status 2; type 2 seeks the volume stream there, and types 7 and 9 reset their filter (RLERStream_Close (00064560), LZHRStream_Close (00065000)), seek the volume stream to the entry's start, re-attach the filter (RLERStream_Open (0006452c), LZHRStream_Open (00064fa4)) and seek the filter to the position. Returns 1 otherwise; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_SetPosition (00056b4c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_GetCapabilities
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x10 (stream, query): for a file handle, query 0 answers 2 and queries 2 and 3 answer 1; for a volume entry, query 0 answers the compression type +0x1e, 2 and 3 answer 1 and 4 answers whether the type is not 2. Anything else answers 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_GetCapabilities (00056cc4) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Flush
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x14: loads this into ECX, MOV AL,1; RET 4; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Flush (00056d2c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_SetIoError
entries.description: (stream): sets the status at +0 to 3 when errno (00083cbf) is 0, otherwise 1, and returns 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_SetIoError (00056d34) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Write
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x18: loads its three arguments into registers, sets status 4 and returns 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Write (00056d5c) in different code.

entries.name: VolRStream_Read
entries.description: VolRStream vtable slot +0x1c (stream, buffer, count): 0 when the status is nonzero, 1 for a count of 0. A file handle reads through read(), VolRStream_SetIoError on -1 and status 2 with 0 returned on a short read. An entry first re-seeks (slot +0xc to +0x16) when the volume stream's position no longer equals +0x1a. A read running past the entry size +0x22 sets status 2, reads size - position + 1 bytes from the volume stream at +0xa itself, sets +0x16 to size + 1 and returns 0; any other reads count bytes through +0xe (the volume stream or the filter), adds count to +0x16 and returns 1. Both update +0x1a to the volume stream's position; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's VolRStream_Read (00056d70) in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_Ctor
entries.description: VolumeGroup constructor, callee-cleaned, (this, dirFirst, dir, extension, mask) in stack order: allocates 0x29 bytes through operator_new when this is null (0 if that fails), clears the 10 volume pointers at +0 and the count byte +0x28, sets VolumeGroup_BufferSize (00083c64) to 0x400, then VolumeGroup_SetGroup with the same arguments, and returns this. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_Ctor (00056180), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_Dtor
entries.description: VolumeGroup destructor (this, flags): returns at once for a null this; otherwise Volume_Dtor (0004ca93)(volume, 3) on each of the count (+0x28) volume pointers, and operator_delete when bit 0 of the flags is set. The class stores no vptr. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_Dtor (000561d8), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_SetBufferSize
entries.description: (size), callee-cleaned: stores max(size, 0x80) in VolumeGroup_BufferSize (00083c64). es2_xref finds one call, from main (00012ec7), with 0x200 just before main calls VolRStream_SetGroup; when that call makes the group, VolumeGroup_Ctor stores 0x400 over it before any volume is loaded. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_SetBufferSize (00056238), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: Path_JoinSkipDrive
entries.description: (name, dir) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies dir, or the empty string at 00083c68 when it is null, into the static buffer 000a0b84, appends name without a leading 'X:' drive prefix and returns the buffer. ES1DBSIM's Path_JoinSkipDrive (00056254), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: Path_SkipDrive
entries.description: (path), callee-cleaned: returns path + 2 when path[1] is ':', else path. ES1DBSIM's Path_SkipDrive (000562bc), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_SetGroup
entries.description: (group, dirFirst, dir, extension, mask) in stack order, callee-cleaned: walks the volumes by index and removes one whose flags (+0x20) share no bit with mask through VolumeGroup_RemoveVolume, then moves on past the volume shifted into its slot; returns when the group holds 10 volumes, then scans Str_Concat4's [dir]'vol\*'<extension> with findfirst and findnext twice, with dir the first time only when dirFirst is nonzero and the second time only when it is 0. Each file whose 'vol\<name>' equals no loaded volume's name (+8, through Path_SkipDrive) is added with VolumeGroup_AddVolume(group, mask, Path_JoinSkipDrive('vol\<name>', that pass's dir)). The count is tested once, before the scans. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_SetGroup (000562d8), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_RemoveVolume
entries.description: (group, index): Volume_Dtor (0004ca93)(volume, 3) on the volume at index, shifts the later pointers down one while they are set, decrements the count byte +0x28 and clears the freed last slot. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_RemoveVolume (00056528), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_AddVolume
entries.description: (group, mask, path) in stack order: Volume_LoadVolume (0004cb1c)(VolumeGroup_BufferSize, mask, path) in stack order, and when that returns a volume, inserts it so the list stays in descending order of the byte at volume +0x1c, then increments the count byte +0x28. It does not test the count. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_AddVolume (000565a4), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_LoadVolume
entries.description: (group, path): returns 0 for a null path or a group of 10 volumes; otherwise, unless a loaded volume's name (+8) equals path, VolumeGroup_AddVolume(group, 0xffffffff, path); returns 1. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_LoadVolume (00056620), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: VolumeGroup_FindEntry
entries.description: (group, entry, path) in stack order: Volume_FindEntry (0004ce15)(volume, entry, path) on each volume in order (count byte +0x28), returning 1 at the first that answers nonzero, else 0. ES1DBSIM's VolumeGroup_FindEntry (000566b8), the same statements in different code.

entries.name: __cinit
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__cinit`, from `cinit.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 33 bytes from here.

entries.name: Runtime_RunStaticCtors
entries.description: No arguments: __cinit's static-constructor walk. Calls each non-zero pointer from 0009a28c down to 0009a218, the last entry first. __cinit (0004defc) is its caller found by es2_xref. The code of ES1DBSIM's Runtime_RunStaticCtors (0005b692), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: __dodtors
entries.description: No arguments: the runtime's static-destructor walk, calling each non-zero pointer from 0009a28c up to 0009a2b0. exit (0004df64) is its caller found by es2_xref. The code of ES1DBSIM's __dodtors (0005b6ad), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: __exit
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__exit`, from `cinit.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 9 bytes from here.

entries.name: ___faterr
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `___faterr`, from `cinit.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 32 bytes from here.

entries.name: exit
entries.description: (status), C convention: calls the atexit functions through _atexitp (000ab4f2), newest first; then calls _hookexitp (000ab57a) with the status and returns when it is set, or else runs __dodtors, calls _fcloseallp (00083fd8) when it is set, and ends through __exit. The code of ES1DBSIM's exit (0005b6f4), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: fflush
entries.description: The runtime's fflush (stream), C convention: a null stream flushes every FILE with flushall and returns 0. Otherwise, for a buffered stream in write mode (flags +0xc & 0x26 == 2) with a buffer (+8) it writes the pending bytes (+0 less the buffer) to the handle +0x10, setting the error bit 0x20 on a short write, resets the pointer +0 to the buffer and the count +4 to the size +0x14; any other stream gets a count of 0. Returns -1 when the error bit is set, else 0. The code of ES1DBSIM's fflush (000753e8), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: fputc
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `fputc`, from `fputc.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 88 bytes from here.

entries.name: fgetc
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `fgetc`, from `fputc.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 69 bytes from here.

entries.name: LZHuffman_Start
entries.description: (coder, source): attaches the source at +0, clears the bit-input state +0x10..+0x15, and builds LZHUF's initial tree: 314 (0x13a) leaves of frequency 1 (frequencies +4) whose child links (+0xc) are 0x273 + i and parent links (+8, from +0x4e6) their node, then the internal nodes 0x13a..0x272 each summing a pair, the sentinel frequency 0xffff at node 0x273 and parent 0 for the root 0x272. LZHUF's StartHuff. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_Start (000827b8), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodeChar
entries.description: (coder, c): walks the parent links (+8, leaf c's at +0x4e6) up to the root 0x272, shifting each node's low bit into the code from the top, then LZHuffman_PutCode(coder, code, bit count) and LZHuffman_Update(coder, c). LZHUF's EncodeChar. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_EncodeChar (000828d0), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodePosition
entries.description: (coder, position): LZHuffman_PutCode with the code 00094304[position >> 6] << 8 and the length 000942c4[position >> 6] (LZHUF's p_code and p_len), then the low six bits << 10 in 6 bits. LZHUF's EncodePosition. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_EncodePosition (00082940), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_DecodeChar
entries.description: (coder): walks the child links (+0xc) from the root (+0x4e4) one LZHuffman_GetBit at a time until a leaf (>= 0x273), LZHuffman_Update's it and returns leaf - 0x273. LZHUF's DecodeChar. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_DecodeChar (00082984), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_DecodePosition
entries.description: (coder): reads a byte with LZHuffman_GetByte, takes the upper six bits from 00094344 and the bit count from 00094444 (LZHUF's d_code and d_len), shifts count - 2 more bits from LZHuffman_GetBit into the byte from below and returns its low six bits | upper << 6, a 12-bit position. LZHUF's DecodePosition. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_DecodePosition (000829e8), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodeEnd
entries.description: (coder): writes the top byte of the bit buffer (+0x13) when bits are pending (+0x15), then a zero byte, each through the stream's slot +0x18. LZHUF's EncodeEnd with a trailing 0. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_EncodeEnd (00082a44), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_GetBit
entries.description: (coder): while the bit count +0x12 is below 9, reads a byte through the source's slot +0x1c (0 when the read fails), ORs it into the 16-bit buffer +0x10 below the bits held and adds 8 to the count; then shifts out and returns the top bit. LZHUF's GetBit. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_GetBit (00082a90), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_PutCode
entries.description: (coder, code, length) in stack order: ORs the code, shifted right by the pending bit count +0x15, into the output buffer +0x13 and adds length to the count; at 8 bits or more writes the buffer's top byte through the stream's slot +0x18, and when 8 still remain its low byte too and keeps code << (length - count). entries.name: LZHuffman_Reconstruct

entries.name: LZHuffman_Update
